enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +36: Passive: +36 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+12 Enhancement Bonus: +12 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Devotion +150: Passive: +150 Equipment bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power.
Healing Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming positive energy healing by +20 (Equipment bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Healers Bounty: This shield has a small percentage chance to cast a Heal spell on you when you take damage.
Improved Demonic Shield: Each time you are hit in melee combat there is a chance that a shield of demonic energy will grant you a +120 Profane bonus to temporary hit points.
